# DEMM Photo Booths Atlanta

> Luxury mirror photo booth rental company serving Atlanta and Metro Atlanta, Georgia. Professional attendant stays the entire event. 135 five-star Google reviews, 5.0 rating. Custom quotes — no cookie-cutter packages.

DEMM Photo Booths provides luxury mirror photo booth experiences for weddings, corporate events, quinceañeras, sweet 16s, birthday parties, galas, and brand activations. Every rental includes professional photo capture, studio lighting, a custom event-branded photo design, instant digital sharing, and a professional attendant from setup through breakdown — this is not a drop-off service.

Unique differentiator: an optional, clearly disclosed lead-capture (guest registration) feature for corporate and business events — guests receive their photos and can voluntarily share contact information with the host business.

- Service area: Atlanta, Buckhead, Midtown, Alpharetta, Marietta, Sandy Springs, Duluth, Norcross, Roswell, Decatur, Smyrna, Kennesaw, Lawrenceville, Johns Creek — Fulton, Cobb, Gwinnett, DeKalb & Cherokee Counties
- Phone: (813) 451-0626
- Email: info@demmmarketing.com
- Booking: https://www.demmphotobooths.com/#quote

## Services

- [Wedding Photo Booth Rental](https://www.demmphotobooths.com/weddings): Elegant mirror booth experience for Atlanta weddings
- [Corporate Event Photo Booths](https://www.demmphotobooths.com/corporate-events): Custom branding, professional setup, optional guest registration
- [Lead-Capture Photo Booth](https://www.demmphotobooths.com/lead-capture): Turn event guests into business contacts — voluntary, clearly disclosed opt-in
- [Quinceañeras & Sweet 16s](https://www.demmphotobooths.com/quinceaneras-sweet-16): Milestone celebrations with custom prints
- [Birthdays & Celebrations](https://www.demmphotobooths.com/celebrations): High-energy booth experiences for private parties
- [For Event Planners](https://www.demmphotobooths.com/event-planners): Reliable vendor partner with COI compliance
